name: titleix-policy-tracker
description: Track proposed and passed laws impacting Title IX across the United States.
author: Title IX Policy Tracker Maintainers <maintainers@titleixpolicytracker.org>

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "npm run desktop:compile && wait-on -t 60000 http://localhost:3000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron electron-dist/main.js"
scripts.desktop:dev:local: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && npm run desktop:copy-assets && cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=local electron electron-dist/main.js
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage-local && npm run desktop:compile && npm run desktop:copy-assets && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:appimage: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage-local && npm run desktop:compile && npm run desktop:copy-assets && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage-local && npm run desktop:compile && npm run desktop:copy-assets && electron-builder --linux AppImage pacman deb rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage-local && npm run desktop:compile && npm run desktop:copy-assets && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage-local && npx @tauri-apps/cli build
